claim: Not universally compatible with SKR, BIGTREETECH or similar boards

findings.finding: Official schematics show a 3.3 V driver logic socket supply (SKR 3 labelled M3.3V). Current adapter uses this rail directly for the external driver's common-positive supply, so it does not create the required 5 V common.
findings.evidence: Official BTT schematics inspected by compatibility reviewer; representative sources below.

models: Any 3.3 V control host with adapter supplied at 5 V
findings.finding: SN74LVC3G06 minimum VIH is 0.7 x VCC for VCC 4.5-5.5 V: 3.5 V at nominal 5 V. A 3.3 V signal is not guaranteed to register high.
On-board TMC2209 drivers; no interchangeable StepStick socket for this plug-in adapter.
Engineering reference for current r0.1; no physical compatibility qualification yet.
BTT documents converted 5 V stepper signals, but connector footprint, socket supply, orientation, clearances and behaviour still require separate qualification.

recommended_future_design_scope: For broader removable-driver-board support, review an adapter with guaranteed 3.3 V/5 V logic acceptance and a defined 5 V common supply independent of whether the host socket rail is 3.3 V or 5 V. Preserve pin/fit and startup qualification per model. This is a proposed revision, not implemented.
